prompt:
Research the official rate limits of the public GitHub REST API for unauthenticated and authenticated requests. Cite the GitHub documentation page and quote the numbers.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
After reviewing the official GitHub REST API documentation, here are the official rate limits for unauthenticated and authenticated requests.

For unauthenticated requests:
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/overview/resources-in-the-rest-api?apiVersion=2022-11-28#rate-limiting | QUOTE: "For unauthenticated requests, the rate limit allows for up to 60 requests per hour." | CLAIM: The rate limit for unauthenticated requests is 60 requests per hour.

For authenticated requests:
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/overview/resources-in-the-rest-api?apiVersion=2022-11-28#rate-limiting | QUOTE: "For API requests using Basic Authentication or OAuth, you can make up to 5,000 requests per hour." | CLAIM: The rate limit for authenticated requests is 5,000 requests per hour.

The documentation also notes that the rate limit for requests to the Search API is different and more restrictive:
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/search?apiVersion=2022-11-28#rate-limit | QUOTE: "The Search API has a custom rate limit. For requests using Basic Authentication, OAuth, or user access tokens, you can make up to 30 requests per minute." | CLAIM: The Search API has a separate rate limit of 30 requests per minute for authenticated requests.

For unauthenticated requests to the Search API:
SOURCE: https://docs.github.com/en/rest/search?apiVersion=2022-11-28#rate-limit | QUOTE: "For unauthenticated requests, the rate limit allows you to make up to 10 requests per minute." | CLAIM: The Search API rate limit for unauthenticated requests is 10 requests per minute.

All rate limits are tracked based on the original requester's IP address for unauthenticated requests, and the authenticated user or OAuth application for authenticated requests.
